profile.headline: Senior software engineer at StreamSets
profile.summary: Goal driven and versatile software developer with over 10 years of experience in web development in banking as well as security sectors. Strong understanding of various programming languages poised to utilize gained knowledge and skills in IT operations and project management to contribute positively to organizational goals while achieving professional development. Extremely organized and resourceful coupled with effective skills and ability to consistently accomplish any tasks or projects. Adaptable and efficient in work situations with changing responsibilities. A team player with strong communication, interpersonal, intuitive, technical, and leadership skills, adept in working efficiently in both independent and team environments.

positions.title: Senior Software engineer
positions.description:
Cyjax helps companies build effective threat intelligence solutions to tackle the ever-growing number of digital threats that organizations and people face today.

- Gathered and defined customer requirements to develop clear specifications for project plans.
- Designed and implemented RESTful API , following best practices (resource- based URLs, standard - - HTTP status codes and verbs, JSON responses).
- Migrated original Yii2 web application to more modern, simple and flexible application by using React and Next.js in the frontend and Laravel in the backend.
- Built a variety of microservices from tweet, malicious domains or pastes monitoring to data leak exposure for our clients using Spring boot, Kafka, Spark, Elasticsearch and Mysql as main technologies.
- Own data integration with third party platforms like Splunk.
- Utilization of python Celery and RabbitMQ as the task queue framework to process long running tasks, email delivery, task on schedule as well as third party Apis connections.
- Participated in design and implementation from scratch of the main web application based in yii2 framework as MVC framework with MySql and Elasticsearch as databases.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Everis develops software within the financial sector and provides system integration services, which are shared by the different companies in the Bank of Santander Group.

- Contributed to daily scrum meetings with team updates.
- Developed support patches for existing software.
- Responsible for developing and unit testing assigned software features and functionalities.
- Analyzed code defects and failures and presented code refactors and design fixes.
- Collaborated with senior software staff to produce new software solutions. Developed app Integration with REST APIs using Spring MVC.
